item.title: PTZ AI Tracking & Calibration: Gain Scheduling, Dead Time Compensation and Master-Detail
item.description: The site called. AI tracking worked fine at the wide end — the target stayed centered and the gimbal followed it smoothly. Pull to telephoto and the gimbal starts swinging left and right, the swing growing until it finally throws the target out of frame. The first instinct is to turn down the PID’s P — but then the wide end stops keeping up and the target drifts out of frame. Same closed loop, two parameter sets, and neither works.
